lamps.steady: The headlamp high beam is turned on.
The side lamps are turned on.
The auto main beam function has switched on the main beam lamps.
The rear fog lamps are turned on.
The front fog lamps are turned on.

lamps.flashing: Flashes when the turning signals or hazard lights are on. Rapid flashing indicates turn signal light failure.

lamps.steady: No valid key is detected. Use correct key or place smart key in cup holder.
lamps.flashing: The remote key battery is low. Replace the battery as soon as possible.

lamps.steady: There is a failure in the airbag system or seat belt. Contact an MG dealer immediately.
The driver or front passenger seat belt is unfastened.
lamps.flashing: The driver or front passenger seat belt remains unfastened.

lamps.steady: Engine fault detected. Stop safely, switch off the engine, and contact an MG dealer.
An engine emissions fault has occurred. Contact an MG dealer as soon as possible.
Coolant temperature is too high. Stop safely, turn engine off, and contact an MG dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: The coolant temperature sensor has failed. Stop safely, turn engine off, and contact an MG dealer.

lamps.steady: Oil pressure is too low. Stop safely, turn engine off, check oil level, and contact MG.
The 12V battery charging system has failed. Contact an MG dealer immediately.
Cruise control system is enabled and in standby.
lamps.flashing: Cruise control system failure detected. Contact an MG dealer as soon as possible.

lamps.steady: Cruise control system is active and operating.

lamps.lamp: Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: Tyre pressure is low. Check tyre pressures.
lamps.flashing: The TPMS has failed. Contact an MG dealer at the earliest opportunity.

lamps.lamp: Stability Control/Traction Control System Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: The stability or traction control system has failed. Contact an MG dealer immediately.
lamps.flashing: The stability or traction control system is actively operating.

lamps.lamp: Stability Control/Traction Control System Off Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: The stability or traction control system is manually switched off.
ABS fault detected. Normal braking is still functional. Contact an MG dealer as soon as possible.
Braking system failure, such as low fluid or brake force distribution failure. Stop safely and contact MG.
lamps.flashing: Parking brake is not released while vehicle speed is above 5 km/h.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) Status Indicator Lamp
lamps.steady: Electronic parking brake is enabled or dynamic braking is active.
lamps.flashing: The electronic parking brake has failed. Contact an MG dealer as soon as possible.

lamps.steady: The auto hold system is operating to assist the driver.

lamps.lamp: Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) System Malfunction Indicator Lamp
lamps.steady: EPB system failure detected or system is under diagnosis. Contact an MG dealer.
HDC is active in standby mode.
lamps.flashing: The vehicle is actively under the control of the HDC system.

lamps.steady: HDC system has failed or detected a fault. Contact an MG dealer immediately.

lamps.lamp: Electric Power Steering System (EPS) Warning Lamp (Yellow)
lamps.steady: EPS system has a general failure and performance is reduced. Stop safely and restart.
lamps.flashing: Electric steering column lock has failed. Stop safely, turn engine off, and contact MG.

lamps.lamp: Electric Power Steering System (EPS) Warning Lamp (Red)
lamps.steady: EPS has a steering angle sensor failure. Contact an MG dealer.
lamps.flashing: EPS has a severe failure and steering will be heavy. Contact an MG dealer immediately.

lamps.steady: Fuel remaining in the tank is low. Refuel as soon as possible.
lamps.flashing: Fuel level continues to fall. Refuel immediately.

lamps.steady: A warning message is stored in the vehicle instrument pack system.

lamps.lamp: Active Speed Limit System Warning Lamp
lamps.steady: Active speed limit system failure detected. Contact an MG dealer as soon as possible.
Active speed limit system is armed or active, displaying the set target speed.
lamps.flashing: Vehicle speed exceeds target speed. System will reduce speed using engine braking.

lamps.steady: Speed assist system failure is detected. Contact an MG dealer.
lamps.flashing: Speed assist system failure is detected. Flashes first then stays on.

lamps.steady: Speed assist system is enabled, displaying the current speed limit.
lamps.flashing: Vehicle speed exceeds the speed limit. Slow down.

lamps.steady: Adaptive cruise function is enabled and in standby.
Adaptive cruise control system is active.

lamps.lamp: Adaptive Cruise Control System Malfunction Indicator
lamps.steady: Adaptive cruise control system failure detected. Contact an MG dealer as soon as possible.
Forward collision assist is disabled or not functioning normally. Contact an MG dealer.
Lane departure warning function is enabled.
lamps.flashing: System failed. Flashes yellow then stays on. Contact an MG dealer.

lamps.steady: Lane departure warning function is active.
Lane departure prevention function is enabled.
